name: the takeover run as a temporary regime
what_it_changes: Within F01, a takeover's play becomes a temporary regime: its rules are enforced by real removals, bans and bots, members perform and test them, its styling is made usable or switched off, and its end is set.
why: Cut rule R3 (tree-D4.md): a level-3 child of F01's key, held by 5 or more of F01's members, whose lines (read whole in _analysis/d4a01_lines_K01_addstep.txt) state a narrower change than F01's. The lines under T3-023 (running an April Fools takeover) state this: 'Fictional commandments are enforced through real removals and approvals' (battlecats); 'A temporary joke becomes a case-sensitive participation rule enforced by automated messages' (monstercat); 'Moderators settle the prank's cutoff by timezone' (warframe); 'Restoring ordinary rules and styling ends the license' (MMA). These are the labelers' how sentences.
